grilled_cheese.title: Classic Grilled Cheese
steps: Spread soft butter on one side of two bread slices.
Place one slice butter-side down in a medium skillet.
Add two slices of cheddar cheese onto the bread.
Place the second slice on top, butter-side up.
Cook for three minutes until golden, then flip.
Cook two more minutes and serve immediately.

scrambled_eggs.title: Fluffy Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk two eggs and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Heat a non-stick pan over low heat with a knob of butter.
Pour the eggs into the pan.
Gently stir with a spatula until soft curds form.
Remove from heat while still slightly wet to avoid overcooking.

chocolate_mug_cake.title: Chocolate Mug Cake
steps: Mix four tablespoons of flour and two tablespoons of cocoa in a mug.
Add two tablespoons of sugar and a pinch of baking powder.
Stir in three tablespoons of milk and one tablespoon of oil.
Microwave on high for ninety seconds.
Let it cool for one minute before eating.

pancakes.title: Classic Pancakes
steps: In a bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Add the milk, egg, and melted butter, then whisk just until the batter comes together; a few small lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered nonstick pan over medium heat. When the pan is hot, pour about one quarter cup of batter for each pancake.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, about 2 minutes.
Flip the pancake and cook the other side until golden brown, about 1 to 2 minutes.
Transfer the pancakes to a plate and serve warm with your preferred toppings.
